description: This file is a Python script for reviewing and analyzing patches in a version control system, focusing on tags like Signed-off-by, Upstream-Status, and CVE, and providing statistics and blame information.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Class representing the review status of a patch, including tags like Signed-off-by, Upstream-Status, and CVE presence.

methods.name: blame_patch
methods.description: Returns the commit history for a given patch filename as a list of strings.

methods.name: patchreview
methods.description: Analyzes a list of patch files for specific tags and statuses, returning a dictionary of Result objects.

methods.name: analyse
methods.description: Generates statistics and optionally blame information for patches based on analysis results.

methods.name: histogram
methods.description: Displays a histogram of patch statuses.
